name: Incorporation
tagline: Start your business on the right legal footing
summary: End-to-end company and firm registration across every structure recognised under Indian law, handled by CA/CS professionals with 10+ years of hands-on filing experience.
intro: Choosing the right legal structure shapes your taxation, liability, fundraising and compliance for years to come. Our incorporation desk manages the entire process — name approval, drafting, digital signatures, filing and the final certificate — so you can focus on building the business, not chasing paperwork.

items.name: Private Limited Company
items.desc: The most common structure for funded start-ups and growing businesses, offering limited liability and easy access to investment.

items.name: LLP Registration
items.desc: A hybrid structure combining the flexibility of a partnership with the liability protection of a company — ideal for professional practices and small teams.

items.name: One Person Company
items.desc: Full corporate status for a solo founder, without needing a second shareholder or director.

items.name: Public Limited Company
items.desc: Structured for businesses planning to raise capital from the public or list on a stock exchange in future.

items.name: Section 8 Company
items.desc: A non-profit company structure for charitable, educational or social objectives, with tax exemptions available.

items.name: Nidhi Company
items.desc: A member-based NBFC structure for cultivating savings and lending among a closed group of members.

items.name: Sole Proprietorship Registration
items.desc: The simplest way to formalise a small or single-owner business with minimal compliance overhead.

name: Compliance
tagline: Stay audit-ready, every filing on time
summary: Every change in your company — a new director, a shifted office, an amended charter — has to be reported to the Registrar of Companies within a fixed window. We track the deadlines so you don't have to.
intro: Corporate compliance isn't a once-a-year event; it's triggered every time something changes inside your company. Missed filings attract penalties that compound daily. Our compliance team maintains a running calendar for every client and files the moment a change is confirmed.

items.name: Add a Director
items.desc: Appoint a new director and update statutory records with the Registrar of Companies.

items.name: Removal of Director
items.desc: Process resignation or removal of a director in line with the Companies Act.

items.name: Add/Remove a Partner in LLP
items.desc: Update the LLP agreement and file the corresponding change with the Registrar.

items.name: Change of Registered Office Address
items.desc: Shift your registered office within or across states with the correct board and shareholder approvals.

items.name: Change/Surrender of DIN
items.desc: Update director details or surrender a Director Identification Number that is no longer in use.

items.name: Appointment of Auditors
items.desc: Appoint or reappoint statutory auditors within the timelines prescribed by the Companies Act.

items.name: Company Name Change
items.desc: Rebrand and legally rename your company with RoC approval and updated certificates.

items.name: MOA/AOA Amendment
items.desc: Amend your Memorandum or Articles of Association to reflect new objects, capital or internal rules.

items.name: Increase Authorised Capital
items.desc: Raise your company's authorised share capital to make room for future fundraising.

items.name: LLP Name Change
items.desc: Rename a Limited Liability Partnership and update all statutory records.

items.name: Statutory Registers
items.desc: Set up and maintain the statutory registers every company is required to keep under law.

name: Trademark & IP
tagline: Protect the name people know you by
summary: From clearing a name for use to defending it against objections, our IP desk handles trademark, copyright and patent filings so your brand identity stays legally yours.
intro: A brand is one of the few assets that grows more valuable the longer you hold it — provided it's registered before someone else claims it. We search, file and follow through on objections so your mark, logo and creative work are properly protected.

items.name: Trademark Registration
items.desc: Register your brand name, logo or tagline under the Trade Marks Act, 1999.

items.name: Search for Trademark
items.desc: Check for conflicting marks before you invest in a brand identity.

items.name: Respond to Trademark Objection
items.desc: Draft and file a reply to an examination objection raised by the Trademark Registry.

items.name: Trademark Watch
items.desc: Ongoing monitoring for new applications that may infringe on your registered mark.

items.name: Trademark Renewal
items.desc: Renew your registration before expiry to keep protection continuous.

items.name: Logo Design
items.desc: Original logo design built to be distinctive and registration-friendly.

items.name: Copyright Registration
items.desc: Register literary, artistic or software works under the Copyright Act.

items.name: Patent Search
items.desc: Prior-art search to assess the novelty of an invention before filing.

items.name: Provisional Patent Application
items.desc: Lock in a priority date early while you finalise the complete specification.

items.name: Permanent Patent
items.desc: File a complete patent application and manage it through to grant.

name: GST
tagline: Registration, returns and reconciliation, handled monthly
summary: GST touches every invoice you raise. We handle registration, monthly and annual returns, e-way bills and notice replies so your input credit is never at risk.
intro: GST compliance is unforgiving of small errors — a mismatched invoice or a missed due date can block input tax credit or trigger a notice. Our GST team reconciles your books every month, not just at filing time, so returns are accurate the first time.

items.name: GST Registration
items.desc: Register for GST when your turnover crosses the threshold or you need it for e-commerce, exports or voluntary compliance.

items.name: Online Legal Consultation
items.desc: One-on-one consultation on GST applicability, rate classification and structuring.

items.name: GSTR-9 Annual Filing
items.desc: Prepare and file the consolidated annual GST return with reconciled turnover figures.

items.name: GST E-Way Bill
items.desc: Generate and manage e-way bills for the movement of goods above the prescribed value.

name: Income Tax
tagline: File on time, claim what you're owed
summary: From salaried individuals to growing companies, we prepare and file income tax returns, respond to notices and advise on tax planning throughout the year — not just in tax season.
intro: Your income tax return is a formal declaration of your income, deductions and tax position for the year — get it wrong and you risk a notice; get it right and you may be owed a refund. We plan ahead of the deadline so filing is accurate and stress-free.

items.name: Income Tax Return Filing
items.desc: Filing for individuals, professionals, firms and companies across all applicable ITR forms.

items.name: Online Tax Consultancy
items.desc: Advisory on tax planning, deductions and structuring income to legally minimise your tax outgo.

items.name: Reply to Notice & Intimation
items.desc: Drafting and filing responses to Income Tax Department notices and intimations under various sections.

name: Payroll
tagline: Payroll compliance that keeps employees and inspectors happy
summary: Professional tax, PF and ESIC touch every payslip you issue. We register, file and reconcile these on a fixed monthly cycle so your payroll team never has to worry about statutory deadlines.
intro: Payroll compliance sits at the intersection of employee trust and statutory law — get it wrong and both suffer. We manage registrations and periodic filings for professional tax, provident fund and ESIC so your HR team can focus on people, not paperwork.

items.name: Professional Tax Registration
items.desc: Register your establishment for professional tax in the applicable state.

items.name: PTEC & PTRC Registration
items.desc: Obtain both employer and employee professional tax registrations where required.

items.name: PF Return Filing
items.desc: Monthly provident fund contribution filing and reconciliation for your workforce.

items.name: ESIC Registration
items.desc: Register your establishment under the Employees' State Insurance scheme.

items.name: ESIC Filing
items.desc: Periodic ESIC contribution filing to keep employee health-insurance cover active.

name: Licenses
tagline: The permits that let you legally operate
summary: Food businesses, importers and exporters, and anyone signing documents digitally each need a specific license or certificate before they can legally operate. We secure and renew them all.
intro: Operating without the right license isn't just a compliance gap — it can shut a business down overnight. We identify exactly which licenses your business needs and manage the full application, renewal and modification cycle.

items.name: FSSAI Registration & License
items.desc: Food safety registration or license depending on the scale of your food business.

items.name: FSSAI Renewal
items.desc: Renew your FSSAI license before expiry to keep operations uninterrupted.

items.name: FSSAI Modification
items.desc: Update your FSSAI license when business details, activities or premises change.

items.name: FSSAI Annual Return Filing
items.desc: File the mandatory annual return with the food safety department.

items.name: Import Export Code (IEC)
items.desc: Obtain the IEC required to import or export goods and services from India.

items.name: IEC Modification
items.desc: Update your Import Export Code when business or address details change.

items.name: Digital Signature Certificate
items.desc: Obtain a Class 3 DSC for signing statutory filings, tenders and e-forms.
